text:
Greengrove Ops: Hey @maria_cs — we're ramping up a new internal 'Summaries' product + a support knowledgebase ingestion. Saw spike in embeddings QPS: 60 -> ~420 over last 48h. Also new ML team wants a private endpoint. Thinking we need Dedicated pilot or quota bump. Renewal in 45 days, want to avoid performance issues. Can we sync?

maria_cs: Thanks for the heads up. @simon_ae @laura_enablement looped. Can you paste the timeseries and example payloads?

Greengrove Ops: embedding calls per minute: [30,40,60,120,300,420]; avg tokens per request: 120. New teams: Product NLP, Support KB, Mobile summarizer (est 200k tokens/day). Auths from multiple service accounts.

simon_ae: Important signal — multi-team + cross-account. @nate_se any infra constraints? Also renewal in ~45d -> sales should be aware @ryan_sales

nate_se: Looking at their tenant, current quota is 500 qps burst across hosted. With 420 embeddings QPS + gen calls could exceed CPU on shared. Recommend Dedicated pilot with 2 pods or temporary quota increase and routing policy. Quick config sample:

```json
{ "autoscale": {"min": 2, "max": 6}, "routing_policy": "tenant_priority", "kv_cache": true, "batching": {"max_tokens": 4096} }
```

laura_enablement: We can fast-track two enablement sessions: infra onboarding + 1hr prompt tuning workshop. I'll prepare a playbook + runbook.

ryan_sales: Noted renewal window. I'll propose a Dedicated trial with a 3-month eval and pilot pricing. @simon_ae please add usage spike metrics to renewal brief.

maria_cs: I'll schedule a 30min triage with Greengrove Ops tomorrow 11am PT. Greengrove, can you share service account names and number of parallel workers?

Greengrove Ops: Service accounts: prod-summarizer, kb-ingest, mobile-svc. Parallel workers: 12 now, planned 40 in two weeks. Latency tail: p95 embeddings 320ms -> 740ms during spike.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll include p95 in the ticket and open a support request for temporary quota increase and tag @infra-bot to provision a pilot cluster.

infra-bot: Support ticket created #SUP-11234. ETA for temp quota bump: ~2 hours. Pilot cluster request filed.

simon_ae: For docs, suggest batching target = 64 items or 4s latency cap and KV prefix caching for summarizer. I'll draft notes in the renewal pack.

Greengrove Ops: Appreciated — will hold off on scaling to 40 until pilot is live. Thanks everyone :pray:
